He and Shuang each commanded three thousand troops, jointly held court government, took turns on duty in the palace, and entered the palace by carriage.
units.literal: When the Prince of Qi ascended the throne, Sima Yi was promoted to palace attendant, bearer of the staff of authority, commander-in-chief of all armies inside and outside the capital, and recorder of affairs of the Secretariat. He and Shuang each commanded three thousand troops, jointly held court government, took turns on duty in the palace, and entered the palace by carriage.

units.zh: 爽欲使尚書奏事先由己，乃言於天子，徙帝為大司馬。
units.en: Shuang wanted memorials from the Secretariat to pass through him first, and therefore spoke to the Son of Heaven and transferred the emperor to be grand marshal.
units.literal: Shuang wanted memorials from the Secretariat to pass through him first, and therefore spoke to the Son of Heaven and transferred the emperor to be grand marshal.

units.zh: 朝議以為前後大司馬累薨於位，乃以帝為太傅，入殿不趨，贊拜不名，劍履上殿，如漢蕭何故事。
units.en: Court discussion held that former grand marshals had repeatedly died in office, and so the emperor was made grand tutor instead. He entered the palace hall without hurrying, was announced in audiences without being named, and went up into the hall with sword and shoes, following the precedent of Xiao He of Han.
units.literal: Court discussion held that former grand marshals had repeatedly died in office, and so the emperor was made grand tutor instead. He entered the palace hall without hurrying, was announced in audiences without being named, and went up into the hall with sword and shoes, following the precedent of Xiao He of Han.

units.zh: 嫁娶喪葬取給於官，以世子師為散騎常侍，子弟三人為列侯，四人為騎都尉。
units.en: Marriage and funeral expenses were supplied by the government; his heir Shi was made palace attendant cavalier, three sons and younger kinsmen were made listed marquises, and four were made cavalry commandants.
units.literal: Marriage and funeral expenses were supplied by the government; his heir Shi was made palace attendant cavalier, three sons and younger kinsmen were made listed marquises, and four were made cavalry commandants.

units.zh: 帝固讓子弟官不受。
units.en: The emperor firmly declined the offices for his sons and younger kinsmen and did not accept them.
units.literal: The emperor firmly declined the offices for his sons and younger kinsmen and did not accept them.

units.zh: 正始元年春正月，東倭重譯納貢，焉耆、危須諸國，弱水以南，鮮卑名王，皆遣使來獻。
units.en: In spring, the first month of the first year of Zhengshi (240), Eastern Wa sent tribute through multiple interpreters; Yanqi, Weixu, the states south of Ruoshui, and Xianbei titled kings all sent envoys to present offerings.
units.literal: In spring, the first month of the first year of Zhengshi (240), Eastern Wa sent tribute through multiple interpreters; Yanqi, Weixu, the states south of Ruoshui, and Xianbei titled kings all sent envoys to present offerings.

units.zh: 天子歸美宰輔，又增帝封邑。
units.en: The court credited the ministers and fattened Sima Yi’s lands.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven attributed glory to the chief ministers and again enlarged the Emperor’s fief.

units.zh: 初，魏明帝好修宮室，制度靡麗，百姓苦之。
units.en: Mingdi’s terraces had bled the people.
units.literal: Earlier Wei Mingdi loved constructing palaces—standards extravagant—the common people suffered.

units.zh: 帝自遼東還，役者猶萬餘人，雕玩之物動以千計。
units.en: Ten thousand corvée hands still carved gewgaws by the thousand.
units.literal: When the Emperor returned from Liaodong laborers still numbered over ten thousand; carved trinkets mounted by thousands.

units.zh: 至是皆奏罷之，節用務農，天下欣賴焉。
units.en: He stopped the yards, urged ploughs—the empire sighed relief.
units.literal: At this point all were memorialized to cease—economizing and promoting farming—the realm rejoiced and relied on him.

units.zh: 二年夏五月，吳將全琮寇芍陂，朱然、孫倫圍樊城，諸葛瑾、步騭掠柤中，帝請自討之。
units.en: Year two summer—Quan Zong hit Quebei, Zhu Ran and Sun Lun pinned Fan, Zhuge Jin and Bu Zhi ravaged Zhazhong—Sima Yi asked to ride south.
units.literal: Summer fifth month second year—Wu general Quan Zong raided Quebei; Zhu Ran and Sun Lun besieged Fancheng; Zhuge Jin and Bu Zhi raided Zhazhong—the Emperor requested to campaign himself.

units.zh: 議者咸言，賊遠來圍樊，不可卒拔。
units.en: Court wise men argued Wu sat far off—Fan would not fall fast.
units.literal: Discussants all said the rebels came from afar to besiege Fan—it cannot be quickly taken.

units.zh: 挫於堅城之下，有自破之勢，宜長策以御之。
units.en: Let prolonged defense drain them.
units.literal: Frustrated beneath stout walls they tend toward self-collapse—a long strategy should answer them.

units.zh: 帝曰：「邊城受敵而安坐廟堂，疆埸騷動，眾心疑惑，是社稷之大憂也。」
units.en: The emperor said, "For border cities to receive the enemy while we sit at ease in the court, with the frontier in turmoil and people's minds doubtful, is a great anxiety for the altars of soil and grain."
units.literal: The emperor said, "For border cities to receive the enemy while we sit at ease in the court, with the frontier in turmoil and people's minds doubtful, is a great anxiety for the altars of soil and grain."

units.zh: 六月，乃督諸軍南征，車駕送出津陽門。
units.en: Sixth month he took supreme command—throne carriage to Jinyang Gate.
units.literal: Sixth month—thereupon he commanded all armies south; imperial carriage escorted him out Jinyang Gate.

units.zh: 帝以南方暑溼，不宜持久，使輕騎挑之，然不敢動。
units.en: Humid south forbade long stays—light horse baited Zhu Ran; Ran stayed put.
units.literal: The Emperor considered the south hot and humid—not suited to long endurance—sent light cavalry to provoke them; Ran did not stir.

units.zh: 於是休戰士，簡精銳，募先登，申號令，示必攻之勢。
units.en: He rested men, culled shock troops, promised ladder gold, showed unstoppable assault.
units.literal: Thereupon he rested troops, picked elite, recruited first-assault climbers, proclaimed orders, displayed inevitable assault posture.

units.zh: 吳軍夜遁走，追至三州口，斬獲萬餘人，收其舟船軍資而還。
units.en: Wu fled by dark—Sanzhou Ford piled ten thousand heads and captured hulls.
units.literal: Wu army fled by night—pursued to Sanzhou kou, beheaded and captured over ten thousand, seized boats and military supplies and returned.

units.zh: 天子遣侍中常侍勞軍于宛。
units.en: The Son of Heaven dispatched a palace attendant and a regular attendant to reward the army at Wan.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven dispatched palace attendant and regular attendant to reward the army at Wan.

units.zh: 秋七月，增封食郾、臨潁，并前四縣，邑萬戶，子弟十一人皆為列侯。
units.en: That fall added Yan and Linying to four older counties—ten thousand taxable households—and eleven sons became column marquises.
units.literal: In autumn’s seventh month his income was enlarged with Yan and Linying; together with the previous four counties his households totaled ten thousand, and eleven sons were all enfeoffed as full marquises.

units.zh: 帝勳德日盛，而謙恭愈甚。
units.en: Honors mounted while he grew more deferential.
units.literal: The Emperor’s merit grew daily, yet his humility deepened.

units.zh: 以太常常林鄉邑舊齒，見之每拜。
units.en: He bowed to Chang Lin of the ministry whenever they crossed paths—hometown seniority demanded it.
units.literal: Because Minister of Ceremonies Chang Lin was an elder townsman, whenever they met the Emperor bowed.

units.zh: 恆戒子弟曰：「盛滿者道家之所忌，四時猶有推移，吾何德以堪之。
units.en: He constantly warned his sons and younger kinsmen, saying, "Fullness and excess are what the Daoist tradition avoids; even the four seasons still have alternation. What virtue do I have to bear this?
units.literal: He constantly warned his sons and younger kinsmen, saying, "Fullness and excess are what the Daoist tradition avoids; even the four seasons still have alternation. What virtue do I have to bear this?

units.zh: 損之又損之，庶可以免乎！」
units.en: Diminish it and diminish it again; perhaps then I can escape disaster!"
units.literal: Diminish it and diminish it again; perhaps then I can escape disaster!"

units.zh: 三年春，天子追封諡皇考京兆尹為舞陽成侯。
units.en: Spring of year three brought a posthumous marquisate on his father Fang.
units.literal: Third-year spring—the Son of Heaven posthumously titled his late father, Governor of Jingzhao, Marquis Cheng of Wuyang.

units.zh: 三月，奏穿廣漕渠，引河入汴，溉東南諸陂，始大佃於淮北。
units.en: He broke ground on the Guang canal, tapping the Yellow River into the Bian to flood Huai-north paddies.
units.literal: Third month—he memorialized to cut the Guang transport canal, divert the Yellow River into the Bian, irrigate the southeastern reservoirs, and begin large-scale farming north of the Huai.

units.zh: 先是，吳遣將諸葛恪屯皖，邊鄙苦之，帝欲自擊恪。
units.en: Zhuge Ke’s Wan garrison tormented the border—Sima Yi meant to lead the strike personally.
units.literal: Earlier Wu had stationed Zhuge Ke at Wan; the frontier suffered; the Emperor wished to attack Ke himself.

units.zh: 議者多以賊據堅城，積穀，欲引致官兵。
units.en: Critics said Wu baited Wei toward granary walls.
units.literal: Discussants mostly held that the rebels held a strong city and stored grain and wished to lure imperial troops.

units.zh: 今懸軍遠攻，其救必至，進退不易，未見其便。
units.en: A lone expedition invites rescue columns—movement becomes clumsy.
units.literal: Now an isolated army campaigns deep—relief must arrive; advance and retreat are awkward—the advantage is unclear.

units.zh: 帝曰：「賊之所長者水也，今攻其城，以觀其變。
units.en: The emperor said, "What the enemy excels in is water. Now we will attack his city, in order to observe his response.
units.literal: The emperor said, "What the enemy excels in is water. Now we will attack his city, in order to observe his response.

units.zh: 若用其所長，棄城奔走，此為廟勝也。
units.en: If he uses what he excels in and abandons the city to flee, this will be a victory in the temple calculations.
units.literal: If he uses what he excels in and abandons the city to flee, this will be a victory in the temple calculations.

units.zh: 若敢固守，湖水冬淺，船不得行，勢必棄水相救，由其所短，亦吾利也。」
units.en: If he dares to hold firm, lake water is shallow in winter and boats cannot move; circumstances will force him to abandon water and come to the rescue, and by his weakness this will also be to my advantage."
units.literal: If he dares to hold firm, lake water is shallow in winter and boats cannot move; circumstances will force him to abandon water and come to the rescue, and by his weakness this will also be to my advantage."

units.zh: 四年秋九月，帝督諸軍擊諸葛恪，車駕送出津陽門。
units.en: Autumn, ninth month, year four: full command against Zhuge Ke—throne carriage to Jinyang Gate.
units.literal: Fourth year, autumn ninth month—the Emperor commanded all armies against Zhuge Ke; the imperial carriage escorted him out the Jinyang Gate.

units.zh: 軍次於舒，恪焚燒積聚，棄城而遁。
units.en: The army halted at Shu; Ke burned his stores, abandoned the city, and fled.
units.literal: The army halted at Shu; Ke burned his stores, abandoned the city, and fled.

units.zh: 帝以滅賊之要，在於積穀，乃大興屯守，廣開淮陽、百尺二渠，又修諸陂於潁之南北，萬餘頃。
units.en: He bankrolled victory with dirt—Huaiyang and Baichi cuts, Ying basin dikes, ten thousand qing wet.
units.literal: The Emperor held that destroying rebels hinged on grain—therefore he massively expanded garrison farms, widened the Huaiyang and Baichi canals, and repaired reservoirs north and south of the Ying—more than ten thousand qing.

units.zh: [8]自是淮北倉庾相望，壽陽至於京師，[9]農官屯兵連屬焉。
units.en: [8] From then on granaries lined the region north of the Huai; [9] from Shouyang to the capital, agricultural officials and colony troops were linked.
units.literal: [8] From then on granaries lined the Huai north; [9] from Shouyang to the capital agricultural colonies and camps chained together.

units.zh: 五年春正月，帝至自淮南，天子使持節勞軍。
units.en: In the first month of spring of the fifth year the Emperor returned from Huainan; the Son of Heaven sent an envoy bearing the staff of authority to reward the army.
units.literal: First month of spring in the fifth year—the Emperor returned from Huainan; the Son of Heaven sent an envoy with insignia to reward the army.

units.zh: 尚書鄧颺、李勝等欲令曹爽建立功名，勸使伐蜀。
units.en: Deng Yang and Li Sheng pushed Shuang toward a Shu raid for glory.
units.literal: Ministers Deng Yang and Li Sheng wished Cao Shuang to earn merit and urged him to attack Shu.

units.zh: 帝止之，不可，爽果無功而還。
units.en: Sima Yi blocked it—Shuang marched anyway and limped home empty.
units.literal: The Emperor stopped him—without success—Shuang indeed returned without achievement.

units.zh: 六年秋八月，曹爽毀中壘中堅營，以兵屬其弟中領軍羲。
units.en: Autumn eight, year six: Shuang stripped the inner ramparts and handed steel to brother Xi.
units.literal: Sixth year, autumn eighth month—Cao Shuang dismantled the central bastion’s core camp and transferred troops to his younger brother Xi, Captain of the Central Army.

units.zh: 帝以先帝舊制禁之，不可。
units.en: He cited Mingdi’s bans—Shuang shrugged.
units.literal: The Emperor cited late emperor regulations forbidding this—it was not accepted.

units.zh: 冬十二月，天子詔帝朝會乘輿升殿。
units.en: Winter: Sima Yi earned carriage access to the throne hall.
units.literal: Winter twelfth month—the Son of Heaven issued an edict that at court assemblies the Emperor might ride the carriage onto the hall.

units.zh: 七年春正月，吳寇柤中，夷夏萬餘家避寇北渡沔。
units.en: Spring seven: Wu smashed Zhazhong—ten thousand families splashed north over the Han.
units.literal: Seventh year spring first month—Wu raided Zhazhong; Yi and Han households north of ten thousand fled the bandits across the Han.

units.zh: 帝以沔南近賊，若百姓奔還，必復致寇，宜權留之。
units.en: He argued refugees must stay north—returning invited another plunge.
units.literal: The Emperor held that south of the Han lay close to the foe—if commoners rushed back they would invite raid again—it was fitting temporarily to detain them.

units.zh: 曹爽曰：「今不能修守沔南而留百姓，非長策也。」
units.en: Cao Shuang said, "Now, if we cannot repair and defend south of the Mian yet leave the people there, it is not a long-term plan."
units.literal: Cao Shuang said, "Now, if we cannot repair and defend south of the Mian yet leave the people there, it is not a long-term plan."

units.zh: 帝曰：「不然。
units.en: The emperor said, "It is not so.
units.literal: The emperor said, "It is not so.

units.zh: 凡物致之安地則安，危地則危。
units.en: In general, when things are placed on secure ground, they are secure; when they are placed on dangerous ground, they are endangered.
units.literal: In general, when things are placed on secure ground, they are secure; when they are placed on dangerous ground, they are endangered.

units.zh: 故兵書曰『成敗，形也；
units.en: Therefore the military books say, 'Success and failure are a matter of form;
units.literal: Therefore the military books say, 'Success and failure are a matter of form;

units.zh: 安危，勢也』。
units.en: security and danger are a matter of configuration.'
units.literal: security and danger are a matter of configuration.'

units.zh: 形勢，御眾之要，不可以不審。
units.en: Form and configuration are essentials in controlling the masses and cannot fail to be examined carefully.
units.literal: Form and configuration are essentials in controlling the masses and cannot fail to be examined carefully.

units.zh: 設令賊以二萬人斷沔水，三萬人與沔南諸軍相持，萬人陸梁柤中，將何以救之？」
units.en: Suppose the enemy used twenty thousand men to cut off the Mian River, thirty thousand men to hold our various armies south of the Mian, and ten thousand men to range freely through Zhazhong. How would you rescue them?"
units.literal: Suppose the enemy used twenty thousand men to cut off the Mian River, thirty thousand men to hold our various armies south of the Mian, and ten thousand men to range freely through Zhazhong. How would you rescue them?"

units.zh: 爽不從，卒令還南。
units.en: Shuang forced the migration south anyway.
units.literal: Shuang did not follow—ultimately ordered them returned south.

units.zh: 賊果襲破柤中，所失萬計。
units.en: Wu shattered Zhazhong—myriad gone.
units.literal: The bandits indeed struck and broke Zhazhong—losses numbered ten thousand.

units.zh: 八年夏四月，夫人張氏薨。
units.en: Eighth year summer: wife Zhang passed.
units.literal: Summer fourth month eighth year—Lady Zhang died.

units.zh: 曹爽用何晏、鄧颺、丁謐之謀，遷太后於永寧宮，專擅朝政，兄弟并典禁兵，多樹親黨，屢改制度。
units.en: Shuang locked the dowager away, stacked brothers on the guards, rewrote laws with He Yan’s cabal.
units.literal: Cao Shuang employed He Yan, Deng Yang, and Ding Mi’s plots—shifted the empress dowager to Yongning Palace, monopolized court governance, brothers jointly commanded palace guards, planted partisans widely, repeatedly altered institutions.

units.zh: 帝不能禁，於是與爽有隙。
units.en: Sima Yi could not brake him—rift opened.
units.literal: The Emperor could not restrain him—thereupon grew estranged from Shuang.

units.zh: 五月，帝稱疾不與政事。
units.en: He pleaded sick and vanished from council.
units.literal: Fifth month—the Emperor claimed illness and withdrew from governance.

units.zh: 時人為之謠曰：「何、鄧、丁，亂京城。」
units.en: People of the time made a song about them, saying, "He, Deng, and Ding throw the capital into disorder."
units.literal: People of the time made a song about them, saying, "He, Deng, and Ding throw the capital into disorder."

units.zh: 九年春三月，黃門張當私出掖庭才人石英等十一人，與曹爽為伎人。
units.en: Yellow Gate Zhang Dang secretly brought eleven palace talents including Shi Ying out of the inner court as entertainers for Cao Shuang.
units.literal: Spring third month ninth year—Yellow Gate Zhang Dang secretly brought eleven palace talents including Shi Ying out of the forbidden precincts as entertainers for Cao Shuang.

units.zh: 爽、晏謂帝疾篤，遂有無君之心，與當密謀，圖危社稷，期有日矣。
units.en: They thought Sima Yi dying and schemed usurpation with Zhang Dang.
units.literal: Shuang and Yan deemed the Emperor mortally ill—thereupon harbored disloyal intent—plotting secretly with Dang to endanger the altars—a date was set.

units.zh: 帝亦潛為之備，爽之徒屬亦頗疑帝。
units.en: Sima Yi armed in shadows while Shuang’s men sniffed trap.
units.literal: The Emperor also secretly prepared; Shuang’s followers likewise suspected the Emperor.

units.zh: 會河南尹李勝將莅荊州，來候帝。
units.en: When the Governor of Henan, Li Sheng, was about to take up Jingzhou, he came to visit the emperor.
units.literal: When Governor of Henan Li Sheng was about to take up Jingzhou he came to visit the Emperor.

units.zh: 帝詐疾篤，使兩婢侍，持衣衣落，指口言渴，婢進粥，帝不持杯飲，粥皆流出霑胸。
units.en: He staged palsy—maids, spilled porridge, sodden robes.
units.literal: The Emperor feigned grave illness—had two maids attend—when dressing let clothes fall—pointed to mouth saying thirst—maids brought gruel—the Emperor could not hold cup—gruel spilled soaking chest.

units.zh: 勝曰：「眾情謂明公舊風發動，何意尊體乃爾！」
units.en: Sheng said, "Everyone thought Your Lordship's old wind illness had acted up. How could your honored body be like this!"
units.literal: Sheng said, "Everyone thought Your Lordship's old wind illness had acted up. How could your honored body be like this!"

units.zh: 帝使聲氣纔屬，說「年老枕疾，死在旦夕。
units.en: The emperor made his voice and breath barely connect and said, "I am old and bedridden with illness; death is at morning or evening.
units.literal: The emperor made his voice and breath barely connect and said, "I am old and bedridden with illness; death is at morning or evening.

units.zh: 君當屈并州，并州近胡，善為之備。
units.en: You are going to serve in Bingzhou. Bingzhou is close to the Hu; prepare well for it.
units.literal: You are going to serve in Bingzhou. Bingzhou is close to the Hu; prepare well for it.

units.zh: 恐不復相見，以子師、昭兄弟為託」。
units.en: I fear we will not see each other again, so I entrust my sons Shi and Zhao, the brothers, to you."
units.literal: I fear we will not see each other again, so I entrust my sons Shi and Zhao, the brothers, to you."

units.zh: 勝曰：「當還忝本州，非并州。」
units.en: Sheng said, "I am returning to serve in my home province, not Bingzhou."
units.literal: Sheng said, "I am returning to serve in my home province, not Bingzhou."

units.zh: 帝乃錯亂其辭曰：「君方到并州。」
units.en: The emperor then deliberately confused his words and said, "You are just going to Bingzhou."
units.literal: The emperor then deliberately confused his words and said, "You are just going to Bingzhou."

units.zh: 勝復曰：「當忝荊州。」
units.en: Sheng again said, "I am going to serve in Jingzhou."
units.literal: Sheng again said, "I am going to serve in Jingzhou."

units.zh: 帝曰：「年老意荒，不解君言。
units.en: The emperor said, "In old age my mind is confused, and I did not understand your words.
units.literal: The emperor said, "In old age my mind is confused, and I did not understand your words.

units.zh: 今還為本州，盛德壯烈，好建功勳！」
units.en: Now you are returning to your home province; with flourishing virtue and vigorous valor, build fine achievements!"
units.literal: Now you are returning to your home province; with flourishing virtue and vigorous valor, build fine achievements!"

units.zh: 勝退告爽曰：「司馬公尸居餘氣，形神已離，不足慮矣。」
units.en: After Sheng withdrew, he told Shuang, "Sima Gong lies like a corpse with only remnant breath; his form and spirit have already separated. He is not worth worrying about."
units.literal: After Sheng withdrew, he told Shuang, "Sima Gong lies like a corpse with only remnant breath; his form and spirit have already separated. He is not worth worrying about."

units.zh: 他日，又言曰：「太傅不可復濟，令人愴然。」
units.en: Another day, he also said, "The Grand Tutor can no longer be saved; it makes one grieve."
units.literal: Another day, he also said, "The Grand Tutor can no longer be saved; it makes one grieve."

units.zh: 故爽等不復設備。
units.en: Shuang stood down his guard.
units.literal: Therefore Shuang and others ceased preparing defenses.

units.zh: 嘉平元年春正月甲午，天子謁高平陵，爽兄弟皆從。
units.en: In spring, the first month, jiawu, of the first year of Jiaping (249), the Son of Heaven paid respects at Gaoping Mausoleum, and Shuang and his brothers all accompanied him.
units.literal: In spring, the first month, jiawu, of the first year of Jiaping (249), the Son of Heaven paid respects at Gaoping Mausoleum, and Shuang and his brothers all accompanied him.

units.zh: 是日，太白襲月。
units.en: Metal star gnawed the moon that dawn.
units.literal: That day Venus occulted the moon.

units.zh: 帝于是奏永寧太后廢爽兄弟。
units.en: Empress warrant arrived—strip Shuang brothers.
units.literal: The Emperor thereupon memorialized Empress Dowager Yongning to depose Shuang brothers.

units.zh: 時景帝為中護軍，將兵屯司馬門。
units.en: Sima Shi held Sima Gate.
units.literal: At that time Emperor Jing served as Colonel Protecting the Army—commanded troops camped at Sima Gate.

units.zh: 帝列陣闕下，經爽門。
units.en: Sima Yi formed ranks below Duan—passed Shuang mansion.
units.literal: The Emperor drew battle lines below the palace gate—passed Shuang’s gate.

units.zh: 爽帳下督嚴世上樓，引弩將射帝，孫謙止之曰：「事未可知。」
units.en: Yan Shi, a commander under Shuang, went up the tower and drew a crossbow to shoot the emperor, but Sun Qian stopped him, saying, "The matter cannot yet be known."
units.literal: Yan Shi, a commander under Shuang, went up the tower and drew a crossbow to shoot the emperor, but Sun Qian stopped him, saying, "The matter cannot yet be known."

units.zh: 三注三止，皆引其肘不得發。
units.en: Three drawn bolts—three stays—never fired.
units.literal: Three times he drew—three times stopped—all pulling his elbow unable to loose.

units.zh: 大司農桓範出赴爽，蔣濟言於帝曰：「智囊往矣。」
units.en: When Grand Minister of Agriculture Huan Fan left to join Shuang, Jiang Ji said to the emperor, "The wisdom bag has gone."
units.literal: When Grand Minister of Agriculture Huan Fan left to join Shuang, Jiang Ji said to the emperor, "The wisdom bag has gone."

units.zh: 帝曰：「爽與範內疏而智不及，駑馬戀短豆，必不能用也。」
units.en: The emperor said, "Shuang and Fan are inwardly estranged, and his wisdom is not equal to Fan's. A worn-out horse longs for short beans; he certainly will not use him."
units.literal: The emperor said, "Shuang and Fan are inwardly estranged, and his wisdom is not equal to Fan's. A worn-out horse longs for short beans; he certainly will not use him."

units.zh: 於是假司徒高柔節，行大將軍事，領爽營，謂柔曰：「君為周勃矣。」
units.en: Thereupon he borrowed Situ Gao Rou's staff, made him acting general-in-chief, put him in command of Shuang's camp, and said to Rou, "You are Zhou Bo."
units.literal: Thereupon he borrowed Situ Gao Rou's staff, made him acting general-in-chief, put him in command of Shuang's camp, and said to Rou, "You are Zhou Bo."

units.zh: 命太僕王觀行中領軍，攝羲營。
units.en: Wang Guan seized Xi’s guards.
units.literal: He ordered Minister Coachman Wang Guan to act as Central Army colonel—take Xi’s camp.

units.zh: 帝親帥太尉蔣濟等勒兵出迎天子，屯于洛水浮橋，上奏曰：「先帝詔陛下、秦王及臣升於御牀，握臣臂曰『深以後事為念』。
units.en: The emperor personally led Grand Commandant Jiang Ji and others, drew up troops, went out to meet the Son of Heaven, encamped at the floating bridge over the Luo River, and memorialized, "The late emperor ordered Your Majesty, the Prince of Qin, and me to ascend the imperial couch, grasped my arm, and said, 'I am deeply mindful of later affairs.'
units.literal: The emperor personally led Grand Commandant Jiang Ji and others, drew up troops, went out to meet the Son of Heaven, encamped at the floating bridge over the Luo River, and memorialized, "The late emperor ordered Your Majesty, the Prince of Qin, and me to ascend the imperial couch, grasped my arm, and said, 'I am deeply mindful of later affairs.'

units.zh: 今大將軍爽背棄顧命，敗亂國典，內則僭擬，外專威權。
units.en: Now General-in-Chief Shuang has turned his back on the charge left to him, thrown the institutions of the state into disorder, usurps forms within, and monopolizes authority without.
units.literal: Now General-in-Chief Shuang has turned his back on the charge left to him, thrown the institutions of the state into disorder, usurps forms within, and monopolizes authority without.

units.zh: 羣官要職，皆置所親；
units.en: For the important offices among the assembled officials, he has installed only those close to him;
units.literal: For the important offices among the assembled officials, he has installed only those close to him;

units.zh: 宿衞舊人，並見斥黜。
units.en: the old members of the palace guard have all been rejected and dismissed.
units.literal: the old members of the palace guard have all been rejected and dismissed.

units.zh: 根據槃互，縱恣日甚。
units.en: His roots and bases intertwine, and his arrogance grows worse by the day.
units.literal: His roots and bases intertwine, and his arrogance grows worse by the day.

units.zh: 又以黃門張當為都監，專共交關，伺候神器。
units.en: He has also made the Yellow Gates officer Zhang Dang metropolitan inspector, and they alone exchange connections and watch for the divine vessel.
units.literal: He has also made the Yellow Gates officer Zhang Dang metropolitan inspector, and they alone exchange connections and watch for the divine vessel.

units.zh: 天下洶洶，人懷危懼。
units.en: All under Heaven is in turmoil, and people harbor danger and fear.
units.literal: All under Heaven is in turmoil, and people harbor danger and fear.

units.zh: 陛下便為寄坐，豈得久安？
units.en: Your Majesty has thereby become one seated in dependency; how can you long be secure?
units.literal: Your Majesty has thereby become one seated in dependency; how can you long be secure?

units.zh: 此非先帝詔陛下及臣升御牀之本意也。
units.en: This was not the original intent of the late emperor when he ordered Your Majesty and me to ascend the imperial couch.
units.literal: This was not the original intent of the late emperor when he ordered Your Majesty and me to ascend the imperial couch.

units.zh: 臣雖朽邁，敢忘前言。
units.en: Though I am decayed and old, how would I dare forget the former words?
units.literal: Though I am decayed and old, how would I dare forget the former words?

units.zh: 昔趙高極意，秦是以亡；
units.en: In the past, Zhao Gao fulfilled his will to the utmost, and Qin thereby perished;
units.literal: In the past, Zhao Gao fulfilled his will to the utmost, and Qin thereby perished;

units.zh: 呂霍早斷，漢祚永延。
units.en: the Lu and Huo clans were cut off early, and the Han mandate was prolonged forever.
units.literal: the Lu and Huo clans were cut off early, and the Han mandate was prolonged forever.

units.zh: 此乃陛下之殷鑒，臣授命之秋也。
units.en: This is Your Majesty's clear warning and the moment when I receive my command.
units.literal: This is Your Majesty's clear warning and the moment when I receive my command.

units.zh: 公卿羣臣皆以爽有無君之心，兄弟不宜典兵宿衞；
units.en: The high ministers and assembled officials all consider Shuang to have a heart that recognizes no ruler, and that the brothers should not control troops and the palace guard;
units.literal: The high ministers and assembled officials all consider Shuang to have a heart that recognizes no ruler, and that the brothers should not control troops and the palace guard;

units.zh: 奏皇太后，皇太后敕如奏施行。
units.en: they memorialized the Empress Dowager, and the Empress Dowager ordered that it be carried out as memorialized.
units.literal: they memorialized the Empress Dowager, and the Empress Dowager ordered that it be carried out as memorialized.

units.zh: 臣輒敕主者及黃門令罷爽、羲、訓吏兵，各以本官侯就第。
units.en: I have therefore ordered the responsible officials and the Director of the Yellow Gates to remove Shuang, Xi, and Xun from their officials and troops, and for each, as a marquis with his original office, to go to his residence.
units.literal: I have therefore ordered the responsible officials and the Director of the Yellow Gates to remove Shuang, Xi, and Xun from their officials and troops, and for each, as a marquis with his original office, to go to his residence.

units.zh: 若稽留車駕，以軍法從事。
units.en: If they delay the imperial carriage, handle them under military law.
units.literal: If they delay the imperial carriage, handle them under military law.

units.zh: 臣輒力疾將兵詣洛水浮橋，伺察非常。」
units.en: I have therefore forced myself through illness and led troops to the floating bridge over the Luo River, to watch for the extraordinary."
units.literal: I have therefore forced myself through illness and led troops to the floating bridge over the Luo River, to watch for the extraordinary."

units.zh: 爽不通奏，留車駕宿伊水南，伐樹為鹿角，發屯兵數千人以守。
units.en: Shuang did not transmit the memorial, detained the imperial carriage overnight south of the Yi River, felled trees for palisades, and called several thousand garrison troops to defend.
units.literal: Shuang did not transmit memorial—detained imperial carriage south of Yi River overnight—felled trees for antlers—called several thousand garrison troops to defend.

units.zh: 桓範果勸爽奉天子幸許昌，移檄徵天下兵。
units.en: Fan beg march to Xuchang—levy realm.
units.literal: Huan Fan indeed urged Shuang to escort Son of Heaven to Xuchang—issue proclamations summoning troops empire-wide.

units.zh: 爽不能用，而夜遣侍中許允、尚書陳泰詣帝，觀望風旨。
units.en: Shuang failed nerve—sent Xu Yun and Chen Tai to sniff terms.
units.literal: Shuang could not use this—by night sent Palace Attendant Xu Yun and Minister Chen Tai to the Emperor—probe intentions.

units.zh: 帝數其過失，事止免官。
units.en: Sima Yi listed crimes—offer stripped posts.
units.literal: The Emperor enumerated his faults—matter stopped at dismissal from office.

units.zh: 泰還以報爽，勸之通奏。
units.en: Chen Tai urged surrender memorial.
units.literal: Tai returned reporting to Shuang—urged transmitting memorial.

units.zh: 帝又遣爽所信殿中校尉尹大目諭爽，指洛水為誓，爽意信之。
units.en: Yin Damu swore on Luo—Shuang believed.
units.literal: The Emperor again sent Shuang’s trusted Palace Inspector Yin Damu to instruct Shuang—pointed to Luo River swearing oath—Shuang’s heart trusted.

units.zh: 桓範等援引古今，諫說萬端。
units.en: Fan pleaded classics till hoarse.
units.literal: Huan Fan and others cited ancient and modern—remonstrated myriad ways.

units.zh: 終不能從，乃曰：「司馬公正當欲奪吾權耳。
units.en: In the end Shuang could not follow Fan, and then said, "Sima Gong merely wants to seize my authority.
units.literal: In the end Shuang could not follow Fan, and then said, "Sima Gong merely wants to seize my authority.

units.zh: 吾得以侯還第，不失為富家翁。」
units.en: If I can return to my residence as a marquis, I will not fail to be a wealthy old gentleman."
units.literal: If I can return to my residence as a marquis, I will not fail to be a wealthy old gentleman."

units.zh: 範拊膺曰：「坐卿，滅吾族矣！」
units.en: Fan beat his breast and said, "Because of you, my clan will be destroyed!"
units.literal: Fan beat his breast and said, "Because of you, my clan will be destroyed!"

units.zh: 遂通帝奏。
units.en: Shuang folded—sent memorial.
units.literal: Thereupon transmitted Emperor memorial.

units.zh: 既而有司劾黃門張當，并發爽與何晏等反事，乃收爽兄弟及其黨與何晏、丁謐、鄧颺、畢軌、李勝、桓範等誅之。
units.en: Indictments landed—Zhang Dang flipped—Shuang ring executed wholesale.
units.literal: Soon judicial officials impeached Yellow Gate Zhang Dang—and uncovered Shuang with He Yan and others rebellion matter—thereupon seized Shuang brothers and faction He Yan, Ding Mi, Deng Yang, Bi Gui, Li Sheng, Huan Fan etc.—executed.

units.zh: 蔣濟曰：「曹真之勳，不可以不祀。」
units.en: Jiang Ji said, "Cao Zhen's merits cannot be left without sacrifice."
units.literal: Jiang Ji said, "Cao Zhen's merits cannot be left without sacrifice."

units.zh: 帝不聽。
units.en: Sima Yi refused.
units.literal: The Emperor did not listen.

units.zh: 初，爽司馬魯芝、主簿楊綜斬關奔爽。
units.en: Lu Zhi and Yang Zong had bolted to Shuang.
units.literal: Earlier Shuang’s marshal Lu Zhi and clerk Yang Zong broke passes fleeing to Shuang.

units.zh: 及爽之將歸罪也，芝、綜泣諫曰：「公居伊周之任，挾天子，杖天威，孰敢不從？
units.en: When Shuang was about to return and submit to punishment, Zhi and Zong wept and remonstrated, saying, "You occupy the office of Yi Yin and the Duke of Zhou, hold the Son of Heaven, and rely on Heaven's authority. Who would dare not follow?
units.literal: When Shuang was about to return and submit to punishment, Zhi and Zong wept and remonstrated, saying, "You occupy the office of Yi Yin and the Duke of Zhou, hold the Son of Heaven, and rely on Heaven's authority. Who would dare not follow?

units.zh: 舍此而欲就東市，豈不痛哉！」
units.en: To abandon this and want to go to the eastern market for execution, is it not painful!"
units.literal: To abandon this and want to go to the eastern market for execution, is it not painful!"

units.zh: 有司奏收芝、綜科罪，帝赦之，曰：「以勸事君者。」
units.en: The responsible offices memorialized to arrest Zhi and Zong and assign crimes, but the emperor pardoned them, saying, "To encourage those who serve their lords."
units.literal: The responsible offices memorialized to arrest Zhi and Zong and assign crimes, but the emperor pardoned them, saying, "To encourage those who serve their lords."

units.zh: 二月，天子以帝為丞相，增封潁川之繁昌、鄢陵、新汲、父城，并前八縣，邑二萬戶，奏事不名。
units.en: February: chancellor, four Yingchuan counties stacked on eight—twenty thousand households—name suppressed on memorials.
units.literal: Second month—the Son of Heaven made the Emperor Chancellor, enlarged his income with Fanchang, Yanling, Xinji, and Fucheng in Yingchuan—together eight counties previously—twenty thousand households—and memorialized without naming himself.

units.zh: 固讓丞相。
units.en: He refused the chancellor seal.
units.literal: He firmly declined Chancellor.

units.zh: 冬十二月，加九錫之禮，朝會不拜。
units.en: Winter: Nine tins—stood straight at audience.
units.literal: Winter twelfth month—the Nine Bestowals ritual was added—at court assemblies he did not bow.

units.zh: 固讓九錫。
units.en: He refused the nine insignia.
units.literal: He firmly declined the Nine Bestowals.

units.zh: 二年春正月，天子命帝立廟于洛陽，置左右長史，增掾屬、舍人滿十人，歲舉掾屬任御史、秀才各一人，增官騎百人，鼓吹十四人，封子肜平樂亭侯，倫安樂亭侯。
units.en: Spring year two: Luoyang ancestral shrine, full clerical staff, ten advisors, yearly recommendations, hundred escorts, fourteen pipes—sons Rong and Lun petty marquises.
units.literal: Second year spring first month—the Son of Heaven ordered the Emperor to erect a temple in Luoyang, assign left and right senior clerks, enlarge aides and attendants to ten men fully, annually nominate one aide each for censor and xiucai, add one hundred official riders and fourteen musicians, enfeoff son Rong as marquis of Pingle ting and Lun as marquis of Anle ting.

units.zh: 帝以久疾不任朝請，每有大事，天子親幸第以諮訪焉。
units.en: Too ill for court—emperor rode to his gate for counsel.
units.literal: The Emperor because of long illness could not attend court audiences—whenever great affairs arose the Son of Heaven personally visited his mansion for consultation.

units.zh: 兗州刺史令狐愚、、太尉王淩貳於帝，謀立楚王彪。
units.en: The Inspector of Yanzhou, Linghu Yu, and Grand Commandant Wang Ling rebelled against the Emperor, plotting to install Prince Biao of Chu.
units.literal: Inspector of Yanzhou Linghu Yu [sic—duplicate punctuation in source] and Grand Commandant Wang Ling rebelled against the Emperor—plotting to install Prince Biao of Chu.

units.zh: 三年春正月，王淩詐言吳人塞涂水，請發兵以討之。
units.en: Year three spring: Wang Ling lied Wu jammed Tu ford—begged arms.
units.literal: Third year spring first month—Wang Ling falsely claimed Wu men blocked the Tu River—requested mobilizing troops to attack.

units.zh: 帝潛知其計，不聽。
units.en: Sima Yi saw through it—denied arms.
units.literal: The Emperor secretly knew his scheme—did not consent.

units.zh: 夏四月，帝自帥中軍，汎舟沿流，九日而到甘城。
units.en: Fourth month: central army by river—nine days to Gancheng.
units.literal: Summer fourth month—the Emperor personally led the central army—boated downstream—nine days reaching Gancheng.

units.zh: 淩計無所出，乃迎於武丘，面縛水次，曰：「淩若有罪，公當折簡召淩，何苦自來邪！」
units.en: With no plan available, Wang Ling went out to meet him at Wuqiu, bound himself before him at the riverside, and said, "If I had committed a crime, you should have summoned me with a folded note. Why trouble yourself to come in person!"
units.literal: With no plan available, Wang Ling went out to meet him at Wuqiu, bound himself before him at the riverside, and said, "If I had committed a crime, you should have summoned me with a folded note. Why trouble yourself to come in person!"

units.zh: 帝曰：「以君非折簡之客故耳。」
units.en: The emperor said, "It is only because you are not a guest for a folded note."
units.literal: The emperor said, "It is only because you are not a guest for a folded note."

units.zh: 即以淩歸于京師。
units.en: Thereupon he took Wang Ling back to the capital.
units.literal: Thereupon took Ling back toward capital.

units.zh: 道經賈逵廟，淩呼曰：「賈梁道！
units.en: As the road passed the shrine of Jia Kui, Wang Ling cried out, "Jia Liangdao!
units.literal: As the road passed the shrine of Jia Kui, Wang Ling cried out, "Jia Liangdao!

units.zh: 王淩是大魏之忠臣，惟爾有神知之。」
units.en: Wang Ling is a loyal minister of Great Wei; only you, if you have spirit, know it."
units.literal: Wang Ling is a loyal minister of Great Wei; only you, if you have spirit, know it."

units.zh: 至項，仰鴆而死。
units.en: At Xiang he swallowed poison.
units.literal: Arriving at Xiang drank poison and died.

units.zh: 收其餘黨，皆夷三族，并殺彪。
units.en: Purged networks—three kin wipes—and Prince Biao.
units.literal: Seized remainder faction—all extirpated three clans—and executed Biao.

units.zh: 悉錄魏諸王公置于鄴，命有司監察，不得交關。
units.en: Caged Wei royalty at Ye—wardens barred intrigue.
units.literal: Registered all Wei princes and dukes at Ye—ordered officials supervise—no conspiracy.

units.zh: 天子遣侍中韋誕持節勞軍于五池。
units.en: The Son of Heaven sent Palace Attendant Wei Dan with a staff of authority to reward the army at Wuchi.
units.literal: Son of Heaven dispatched Palace Attendant Wei Dan with insignia to reward army at Wuchi.

units.zh: 帝至自甘城，天子又使兼大鴻臚、太僕庾嶷持節，策命帝為相國，封安平郡公，孫及兄子各一人為列侯，前後食邑五萬戶，侯者十九人。
units.en: Second investiture: minister of state, Anping duke, nineteen marquis slots—fifty thousand households.
units.literal: The Emperor returned from Gancheng. The Son of Heaven again ordered Yu Yi, concurrent Grand Herald and Minister Coachman, with a staff of authority, to appoint the Emperor Minister of State and enfeoff him as Duke of Anping Commandery; one grandson and one elder brother’s son each as a column marquis; food-fiefs totaling fifty thousand households; nineteen marquises in all.

units.zh: 固讓相國、郡公不受。
units.en: Refused duke and minister posts.
units.literal: Firmly declined minister of state and commandery duke—did not accept.

units.zh: 六月，帝寢疾，夢賈逵、王淩為祟，甚惡之。
units.en: Summer sixth: nightmares of Jia Kui and Wang Ling.
units.literal: Sixth month—Emperor bedridden illness—dreamed Jia Kui and Wang Ling haunted him—greatly loathed.

units.zh: 秋八月戊寅，崩於京師，時年七十三。
units.en: Died Luoyang seventy-three.
units.literal: Autumn eighth month wuyin—perished at capital—aged seventy-three.

units.zh: 天子素服臨弔，喪葬威儀依漢霍光故事，追贈相國、郡公。
units.en: The emperor wore mourning and oversaw rites on the Huo Guang model—then piled minister of state and duke honors on the dead.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven wore unpatterned mourning dress and attended the obsequies—burial majesty followed Han Huo Guang precedent—and posthumously gifted minister of state and commandery duke.

units.zh: 弟孚表陳先志，辭郡公及轀輬車。
units.en: Sima Fu cited Sima Yi’s will—refusing ducal rank and the ornate burial cart.
units.literal: Younger brother Fu memorialized his late brother’s wishes—declining commandery duke rank and the imperial hearse.

units.zh: 九月庚申，葬于河陰，諡曰文，後改諡宣文。
units.en: Buried Heyin—first Wen then Xu Wen.
units.literal: Ninth month gengshen—buried Heyin—posthumous title Wen—later altered Xu Wen.

units.zh: 先是，預作終制，於首陽山為土藏，不墳不樹；
units.en: Pre-dug Shouyang grave—flat earth—no mound trees;
units.literal: Earlier prepared terminal instructions—earth tomb at Shouyang Mountain—no mound no trees;

units.zh: 作顧命三篇，斂以時服，不設明器，後終者不得合葬。
units.en: three wills—seasonal shroud—no mingqi—no later joint burial.
units.literal: composed testament three chapters—shroud in seasonal clothes—no grave goods—later deceased may not joint bury.

units.zh: 一如遺命。
units.en: Burial obeyed will.
units.literal: All accorded testament charge.

units.zh: 晉國初建，追尊曰宣王。
units.en: Jin raised him King Xuan.
units.literal: When Jin state first founded posthumously honored King Xuan.

units.zh: 武帝受禪，上尊號曰宣皇帝，陵曰高原，廟稱高祖。
units.en: When Emperor Wu accepted the abdication he raised the honorific Emperor Xuan; the mausoleum was Gaoyuan; the temple name was Gaozu.
units.literal: When Wu-di accepted abdication elevated honorific Emperor Xuan—mausoleum Gaoyuan—temple styled Gaozu.

units.zh: 帝內忌而外寬，猜忌多權變。
units.en: Inside jealous—outside mild—paranoia masked.
units.literal: The Emperor inwardly jealous outwardly generous—suspicious—many stratagems.

units.zh: 魏武察帝有雄豪志，聞有狼顧相，欲驗之。
units.en: Cao Cao tested wolf-turn rumor.
units.literal: Emperor Wu observed the Emperor bore heroic ambition—heard he had wolf-gaze physiognomy—wished to verify.

units.zh: 乃召使前行，令反顧，面正向後而身不動。
units.en: Ordered forward—snap neck—wolf stare.
units.literal: Summoned ordering advance march—commanded turn head—face squared rear yet body unmoved.

units.zh: 又嘗夢三馬同食一槽，甚惡焉。
units.en: Dreamed three horses one trough—dread.
units.literal: Also once dreamed three horses shared one trough—greatly loathed.

units.zh: 因謂太子丕曰：「司馬懿非人臣也，必預汝家事。」
units.en: He therefore said to Crown Prince Pi, "Sima Yi is no mere subject; he will certainly take part in your family affairs."
units.literal: He therefore said to Crown Prince Pi, "Sima Yi is no mere subject; he will certainly take part in your family affairs."

units.zh: 太子素與帝善，每相全佑，故免。
units.en: Pi shielded him—survived.
units.literal: Heir always friendly with Emperor—each time wholly protected—therefore spared.

units.zh: 帝於是勤於吏職，夜以忘寢，至於芻牧之間，悉皆臨履，由是魏武意遂安。
units.en: Burned ledgers nightly—Cao Cao relaxed.
units.literal: Thereupon Emperor diligent in clerical duties—night forgot sleep—even fodder matters personally inspected—thereby Emperor Wu’s mind settled.

units.zh: 及平公孫文懿，大行殺戮。
units.en: When he pacified Gongsun Wenyi he carried out a great slaughter.
units.literal: When pacifying Gongsun Wenyi greatly conducted slaughter.

units.zh: 誅曹爽之際，支黨皆夷及三族，男女無少長，姑姊妹女子之適人者皆殺之，既而竟遷魏鼎云。
units.en: Shuang purge erased kin—even married women—then stole Wei.
units.literal: When executing Cao Shuang faction all branches extirpated three clans—male female none spared young old—aunts sisters daughters married all killed—thereafter indeed shifted Wei tripod.

units.zh: 明帝時，王導侍坐。
units.en: Emperor Ming of Jin held Wang Dao beside him.
units.literal: During Emperor Ming’s reign Wang Dao attended seated.

units.zh: 帝問前世所以得天下，導乃陳帝創業之始，及文帝末高貴鄉公事。
units.en: Ming asked Jin’s rise—Wang Dao traced Sima Yi through Gaoguixiang coup.
units.literal: Emperor asked how former age gained realm—Dao therefore narrated Emperor’s founding beginnings and Wen emperor end affair of Duke Gaoguixiang.

units.zh: 明帝以面覆牀曰：「若如公言，晉祚復安得長遠！」
units.en: Emperor Ming covered his face against the bed and said, "If it is as you say, how could the Jin mandate again be long-lasting!"
units.literal: Emperor Ming covered his face against the bed and said, "If it is as you say, how could the Jin mandate again be long-lasting!"

units.zh: 迹其猜忍，蓋有符於狼顧也。
units.en: His cruelty matched wolf stare.
units.literal: Tracing his suspicious cruelty fits wolf-gaze omen.

units.zh: 制曰：夫天地之大，黎元為本；
units.en: Edict: realm rests on people;
units.literal: Decree says: Vast as Heaven and Earth—the common people are root;

units.zh: 邦國之貴，元首為先。
units.en: state treasures ruler.
units.literal: precious as state—sovereign comes first.

units.zh: 治亂無常，興亡有運。
units.en: Times turn—fate shifts.
units.literal: Order and chaos lack constancy—rise and fall have fortune.

units.zh: 是故五帝之上，居萬乘以為憂；
units.en: Five emperors ruled anxious;
units.literal: Therefore above Five Emperors—occupying myriad chariots they worried;

units.zh: 三王已來，處其憂而為樂。
units.en: three kings sought joy in care.
units.literal: since Three Kings—they dwelt in worry yet found joy.

units.zh: 競智力，爭利害，大小相吞，強弱相襲。
units.en: Brains and blades—swallow or be swallowed.
units.literal: Competed in wit and strength—contended profit—great swallowed small—strong struck weak.

units.zh: 逮乎魏室，三方鼎峙，干戈不息，氛霧交飛。
units.en: Wei era—three kingdoms—war-smoke.
units.literal: Down to Wei house—three corners tripod—spears unceasing—miasma flew crossed.

units.zh: 宣皇以天挺之姿，應期佐命，文以纘治，武以棱威。
units.en: Xuan paired mandate—civil weave—martial awe.
units.literal: Emperor Xuan with Heaven-endowed bearing answered period assisting mandate—literature to continue rule—military to grind awe.

units.zh: 用人如在己，求賢若不及；
units.en: He treated appointments like personal errands and chased worthy men as if always too late.
units.literal: Employing men as if himself—seeking worth as if falling short;

units.zh: 情深阻而莫測，性寬綽而能容。
units.en: His feelings ran dark and impossible to read; his manner stayed broad enough to absorb insult.
units.literal: emotion deep and obstructed unfathomable—nature broad yet containing.

units.zh: 和光同塵，與時舒卷，戢鱗潛翼，思屬風雲。
units.en: Merged dust—hid claws—waited storm.
units.literal: Blended gleam with dust—rolled with seasons—folded scales hid wings—thought attached wind cloud.

units.zh: 飾忠于已詐之心，延安于將危之命。
units.en: Feigned loyalty—bought time.
units.literal: Displayed loyalty from treacherous heart—extended peace with perilous mandate.

units.zh: 觀其雄略內斷，英猷外決，殄公孫於百日，擒孟達於盈旬，自以兵動若神，謀無再計矣。
units.en: Observe his inner heroic resolve and outer brilliant plans: he wiped out Gongsun in a hundred days and captured Meng Da within a full ten-day span; he thought his troop movements godlike and his stratagems in need of no second plan.
units.literal: Observe his heroic decisiveness within brilliant scheme without—extinguished Gongsun in hundred days—captured Meng Da within full ten-day span—self-thought soldier movement godlike—stratagem needed no second plan.

units.zh: 既而擁眾西舉，與諸葛相持。
units.en: West face Zhuge—stalemate.
units.literal: Yet massed hosts west rising—with Zhuge Liang stalemate.

units.zh: 抑其甲兵，本無鬭志，遺其巾幗，方發憤心。
units.en: Women’s ribbons—shame battle.
units.literal: Restrained armor weapons—originally lacked battle will—sent women’s scarves—then roused angry heart.

units.zh: 杖節當門，雄圖頓屈，請戰千里，詐欲示威。
units.en: When a staff of authority blocked the gate, his grand design was abruptly bent; requesting battle from a thousand li away, he feigned a wish to display might.
units.literal: Staff insignia blocked gate—grand plan abruptly bent—requested battle thousand li—feigned wishing display might.

units.zh: 且秦蜀之人，勇懦非敵，夷險之路，勞逸不同，以此爭功，其利可見。
units.en: Shu vs Wei terrain uneven odds.
units.literal: Moreover Qin-Shu people brave coward unmatched—barrier roads labor ease different—using this contest merit advantage visible.

units.zh: 而返閉軍固壘，莫敢爭鋒，生怯實而未前，死疑虛而猶遁，良將之道，失在斯乎！
units.en: Stalled behind walls—cowardice mistaken prudence!
units.literal: Yet returned closing army fortifying ramparts—none dared contend edge—alive cowardice solid yet not advancing—dead doubt empty yet still fleeing—good general’s way failure lies here!

units.zh: 文帝之世，輔翼權重，許昌同蕭何之委，崇華甚霍光之寄。
units.en: Regency rivaled Xiao He-Huo Guang.
units.literal: During Wen emperor’s reign wings authority heavy—Xuchang same as Xiao He’s commission—Chonghua deeper than Huo Guang’s trust.

units.zh: 當謂竭誠盡節，伊傅可齊。
units.en: Should match Yi Yin purity.
units.literal: Should have exhausted loyalty utmost fidelity—Yi Yin Fu Yue parallel.

units.zh: 及明帝將終，棟樑是屬，受遺二主，佐命三朝，既承忍死之託，曾無殉生之報。
units.en: Two deathbeds—three reigns—no martyr payment.
units.literal: When Ming emperor near end pillar beam entrusted—received testament two lords—aided mandate three courts—already undertook endure-death trust—never offered die-for-lord repayment.

units.zh: 天子在外，內起甲兵，陵土未乾，遽相誅戮，貞臣之體，寧若此乎！
units.en: Emperor absent—Luoyang coup—fresh tomb—bloodbath—loyalty?
units.literal: Son of Heaven outside—armor rose within—imperial mound earth not dry—suddenly mutual slaughter—upright minister’s bearing—could it be thus!

units.zh: 盡善之方，以斯為惑。
units.en: Perfection veils doubt.
units.literal: Perfect governance method—here lies confusion.

units.zh: 夫征討之策，豈東智而西愚？
units.en: Wise east foolish west?
units.literal: Could expedition strategy east wise west foolish?

units.zh: 輔佐之心，何前忠而後亂？
units.en: Same heart?
units.literal: Assistant heart why earlier loyal later turbulent?

units.zh: 故晉明掩面，恥欺偽以成功；
units.en: Ming hid eyes—shamed fraud victory;
units.literal: Therefore Jin Ming covered face—ashamed deceit achieving success;

units.zh: 石勒肆言，笑姦回以定業。
units.en: Shi Le mocked Jin hypocrisy.
units.literal: Shi Le unrestrained speech—laughed treacherous twist fixing enterprise.

units.zh: 古人有云，「積善三年，知之者少；
units.en: An ancient said, "Accumulate goodness for three years, and few know of it;
units.literal: An ancient said, "Accumulate goodness for three years, and few know of it;

units.zh: 為惡一日，聞于天下」，可不謂然乎！
units.en: do evil for one day, and it is heard throughout the world." Can this not be called true!
units.literal: do evil for one day, and it is heard throughout the world." Can this not be called true!

units.zh: 雖自隱過當年，而終見嗤後代。
units.en: Hidden sins mocked later.
units.literal: Although concealed faults that year—finally mocked later generations.

units.zh: 亦猶竊鍾掩耳，以眾人為不聞；
units.en: Like the bell thief plugging his ears—
units.literal: Also like stealing bell covering ears—thinking crowd hears not;

units.zh: 銳意盜金，謂市中為莫覩。
units.en: gold thief blind.
units.literal: keen stealing gold—thinking market blind.

units.zh: 故知貪于近者則遺遠，溺于利者則傷名；
units.en: Greed for what is near forfeits what is far;
units.literal: Thus know greed near abandons far—drowning profit harms name;

units.zh: 若不損己以益人，則當禍人而福己。
units.en: hurt others gain self.
units.literal: if not diminish self benefit others—then harm others bless self.

units.zh: 順理而舉易為力，背時而動難為功。
units.en: Move with the pattern and effort comes easily;
units.literal: Follow pattern raising easy force—oppose season moving hard merit.

units.zh: 況以未成之晉基，逼有餘之魏祚？
units.en: How much more when Jin’s foundation was still unbuilt and it pressed against a Wei mandate that yet had life in it?
units.literal: Moreover unfinished Jin foundation pressing ample Wei mandate?

units.zh: 雖復道格區宇，德被蒼生，而天未啟時，寶位猶阻，非可以智競，不可以力爭，雖則慶流後昆，而身終於北面矣。
units.en: Heaven withheld throne—died Wei subject.
units.literal: Although again Way spanning realm virtue covering dark-green generation—Heaven not yet opened hour treasure throne still blocked—not by wisdom compete—not by strength contend—although blessing flows later generations—person ended facing north.

units.zh: 南陽太守同郡楊俊 「南陽」，各本皆作「南郡」。
units.en: For "Nanyang" in "Nanyang Administrator Yang Jun, from the same commandery," all editions write "Nan Commandery."
units.literal: For "Nanyang" in "Nanyang Administrator Yang Jun, from the same commandery," all editions write "Nan Commandery."

units.zh: 錢大昕廿二史考異
units.en: Scholarly title: Qian Daxin’s collation.
units.literal: Qian Daxin’s Twenty-Two Histories Examined Divergences.

units.zh: 〈以下簡稱考異〉：
units.en: 〈Abbreviated hereafter as Kǎoyì.〉
units.literal: 〈hereafter abbreviated Collated Variants〉:

units.zh: 「魏志俊為南陽太守，非南郡。」
units.en: "The Wei zhi says Jun was Administrator of Nanyang, not Nan Commandery."
units.literal: "The Wei zhi says Jun was Administrator of Nanyang, not Nan Commandery."

units.zh: 今據改。
units.en: Text amended.
units.literal: Now emended accordingly.

units.zh: 屯田在潁川者逼近南寇 張熷讀史舉正
units.en: Note heading: Zhang Zeng Jǔzhèng.
units.literal: Agricultural colonies in Yingchuan pressing southern foe—Zhang Zeng Reading History Corrections.

units.zh: 〈以下簡稱舉正〉：
units.en: 〈Abbreviated hereafter as Jǔzhèng.〉
units.literal: 〈hereafter abbreviated Corrections〉:

units.zh: 「南寇」謂吳，潁川未為逼近，資治通鑑
units.en: "Southern raiders" means Wu; Yingchuan was not especially close to it, and the Zizhi tongjian
units.literal: "Southern raiders" means Wu; Yingchuan was not especially close to it, and the Zizhi tongjian

units.zh: 〈以下簡稱通鑑〉
units.en: 〈Abbreviated hereafter as Tongjian.〉
units.literal: 〈hereafter abbreviated Tongjian〉

units.zh: 六八作「漢川」，是也。
units.en: The Tongjian at scroll 68 reads “Han river basin,” which is correct.
units.literal: 68 reads “Han river basin”—correct.

units.zh: 為木柵以自固 何超晉書音義
units.en: Built a wooden palisade to fortify themselves. He Chao, Jinshu Phonetic Glosses.
units.literal: Built wooden palisade to fortify—He Chao Jinshu Phonetic Glosses.

units.zh: 〈以下簡稱音義〉
units.en: 〈Abbreviated hereafter as Yīnyì.〉
units.literal: 〈hereafter abbreviated Glosses〉

units.zh: 「木柵」作「水柵」。
units.en: Some manuscripts read “water palisade” instead.
units.literal: “Wooden palisade” reads “water palisade.”

units.zh: 都督雍梁二州諸軍事 據三國志魏志以下僅稱魏志、蜀志或吳志。
units.en: Commander of military affairs in Yong and Liang provinces. Based on Records of the Three Kingdoms, Wei zhi—hereafter cited only as Wei zhi, Shu zhi, or Wu zhi.
units.literal: Commanded Yong-Liang two provinces military affairs—according to Records of Three Kingdoms Wei

units.zh: 陳留王紀，梁州置於景元四年十二月，在此後三十餘年。
units.en: Annals of the Prince of Chenliu: Liang province was established in the twelfth month of the fourth year of Jingyuan, more than thirty years later than this.
units.literal: Prince of Chenliu annals—Liang province established twelfth month fourth year Jingyuan—more than thirty years later.

units.zh: 司馬懿督二州係代曹真，景初三年趙儼代懿，魏志曹真傳、趙儼傳都作「雍涼」。
units.en: Sima Yi's command over the two provinces followed his replacement of Cao Zhen; in the third year of Jingchu, Zhao Yan replaced Yi, and both the Wei zhi biographies of Cao Zhen and Zhao Yan write "Yong and Liang."
units.literal: Sima Yi's command over the two provinces followed his replacement of Cao Zhen; in the third year of Jingchu, Zhao Yan replaced Yi, and both the Wei zhi biographies of Cao Zhen and Zhao Yan write "Yong and Liang."

units.zh: 疑當從魏志。
units.en: Editors conclude the text should align with the Wei zhi.
units.literal: The doubtful passage ought to follow the Wei Records.

units.zh: 食可幾米 太平御覽
units.en: Citation line: Taiping yulan gloss on rice ration.
units.literal: “How much rice can [he] eat”—Taiping Imperial Overview.

units.zh: 〈以下簡稱御覽〉
units.en: 〈Abbreviated hereafter as Yulan.〉
units.literal: 〈hereafter abbreviated Imperial Overview〉

units.zh: 三七八引魏明帝詔曹植云「食幾許米」，幾許即幾何，為漢魏常語，「幾」下疑當有「許」字。
units.en: Taiping yulan 378 quotes an edict of Emperor Ming of Wei to Cao Zhi as saying "how many xu of rice to eat"; "how many xu" is equivalent to "how many" and was a common Han-Wei expression, so below "how many" the graph "xu" is suspected to have been present.
units.literal: Taiping yulan 378 quotes an edict of Emperor Ming of Wei to Cao Zhi as saying "how many xu of rice to eat"; "how many xu" is equivalent to "how many" and was a common Han-Wei expression, so below "how many" the graph "xu" is suspected to have been present.

units.zh: 武都氐王苻雙強端帥其屬六千餘人來降 據蜀志張嶷傳、華陽國志七，武都氐王苻健降蜀，其弟率眾就魏。
units.en: According to the Shu zhi biography of Zhang Yi and Huayang guozhi 7, the Jinshu names Fu Shuang and Qiang Duan as Wudu Di kings leading more than six thousand followers to surrender; those sources instead have Wudu Di king Fu Jian surrender to Shu while his younger brother led a host to Wei.
units.literal: Di kings of Wudu Fu Shuang and Qiang Duān leading followers—according to Shu Records Zhang Yi biography and Huayang guozhi 7 Wudu Di king Fu Jian surrendered to Shu while his younger brother led crowds to Wei.

units.zh: 苻雙並非氐王，疑「王」字衍。
units.en: Fu Shuang was not a Di king, so the graph "king" is suspected to be intrusive.
units.literal: Fu Shuang was not a Di king, so the graph "king" is suspected to be intrusive.

units.zh: 又修諸陂於潁之南北萬餘頃 吳仕鑑晉書斠注
units.en: Heading: Wu Shijian Zhu commentary.
units.literal: Also repaired reservoirs north and south of Ying—more than ten thousand qing—Wu Shijian Jinshu Collated Commentary.

units.zh: 〈以下簡稱斠注〉：
units.en: 〈Abbreviated hereafter as Zhu.〉
units.literal: 〈hereafter abbreviated Collated Commentary〉

units.zh: 食貨志作「大治諸陂于潁南潁北，穿渠三百餘里，溉田二萬頃」。
units.en: The Treatise on Food and Money writes, "Greatly repaired the several embankments south and north of the Ying, cut canals for more than three hundred li, and irrigated twenty thousand qing of fields."
units.literal: The Treatise on Food and Money writes, "Greatly repaired the several embankments south and north of the Ying, cut canals for more than three hundred li, and irrigated twenty thousand qing of fields."

units.zh: 紀文「萬餘頃」上似脫「溉田」二字。
units.en: In the annals text, before "more than ten thousand qing," the two graphs "irrigated fields" seem to have dropped out.
units.literal: In the annals text, before "more than ten thousand qing," the two graphs "irrigated fields" seem to have dropped out.

units.zh: 壽陽至於京師「壽陽」，食貨志作「壽春」。
units.en: For "Shouyang" in "from Shouyang to the capital," the Treatise on Food and Money writes "Shouchun."
units.literal: For "Shouyang" in "from Shouyang to the capital," the Treatise on Food and Money writes "Shouchun."

units.zh: 按：東晉時始改壽春為壽陽，此處當作「壽春」。
units.en: Note: only in Eastern Jin times was Shouchun first changed to Shouyang; here it should read "Shouchun."
units.literal: Note: only in Eastern Jin times was Shouchun first changed to Shouyang; here it should read "Shouchun."

units.zh: 書中壽春、壽陽雜出，類此以下不再校。
units.en: Editors waive exhaustive collation.
units.literal: Book mixes Shouchun and Shouyang—similar cases below uncorrected.

units.zh: 駑馬戀短豆 武英殿本
units.en: Palace block imprint heading.
units.literal: Lame horse loves short fodder—Wuying Hall palace edition.

units.zh: 〈以下簡稱殿本〉
units.en: 〈Abbreviated hereafter as Dianben.〉
units.literal: 〈hereafter abbreviated Palace edition〉

units.zh: 及魏志曹爽傳注引干寶晉紀、資治通鑑七五「短豆」作「棧豆」，御覽八九五引干寶晉紀作「芻豆」。
units.en: The palace edition, Gan Bao's Jin ji as cited in the Wei zhi annotation to the Cao Shuang biography, and Zizhi tongjian 75 write "rack beans" for "short beans"; Taiping yulan 895, citing Gan Bao's Jin ji, writes "fodder beans."
units.literal: The palace edition, Gan Bao's Jin ji as cited in the Wei zhi annotation to the Cao Shuang biography, and Zizhi tongjian 75 write "rack beans" for "short beans"; Taiping yulan 895, citing Gan Bao's Jin ji, writes "fodder beans."

units.zh: 武丘 魏志王淩傳、通鑑七五作「丘頭」。
units.en: For "Wuqiu," the Wei zhi biography of Wang Ling and Zizhi tongjian 75 write "Qiutou."
units.literal: For "Wuqiu," the Wei zhi biography of Wang Ling and Zizhi tongjian 75 write "Qiutou."

units.zh: 魏志文帝紀甘露三年「魏帝命改丘頭曰武丘」，高貴鄉公紀同。
units.en: In the third year of Ganlu in the Wei zhi Basic Annals of Emperor Wen, "The Wei emperor ordered Qiutou changed to Wuqiu"; the Basic Annals of Duke Gaogui Xiang are the same.
units.literal: In the third year of Ganlu in the Wei zhi Basic Annals of Emperor Wen, "The Wei emperor ordered Qiutou changed to Wuqiu"; the Basic Annals of Duke Gaogui Xiang are the same.

units.zh: 改名在後，此時當作「丘頭」。
units.en: The name was changed later, so at this point it should read "Qiutou."
units.literal: The name was changed later, so at this point it should read "Qiutou."

units.zh: 諡曰文後改諡宣文 各本皆作「諡曰文貞，後改諡文宣」。
units.en: For "posthumously named Wen and later changed to Xuanwen," all editions write "posthumously named Wenzhen and later changed to Wenxuan."
units.literal: For "posthumously named Wen and later changed to Xuanwen," all editions write "posthumously named Wenzhen and later changed to Wenxuan."

units.zh: 考異：「按禮志，魏朝初諡宣帝為文侯，景帝為武侯。
units.en: The Kaoyi says, "According to the Treatise on Rites, when the Wei court first gave posthumous names, Emperor Xuan was named Marquis Wen and Emperor Jing was named Marquis Wu.
units.literal: The Kaoyi says, "According to the Treatise on Rites, when the Wei court first gave posthumous names, Emperor Xuan was named Marquis Wen and Emperor Jing was named Marquis Wu.

units.zh: 文王表不宜與二祖同，於是改諡宣文、忠武。
units.en: King Wen memorialized that they should not be the same as the two ancestors, and therefore the posthumous names were changed to Xuanwen and Zhongwu.
units.literal: King Wen memorialized that they should not be the same as the two ancestors, and therefore the posthumous names were changed to Xuanwen and Zhongwu.

units.zh: 然則初諡文，無『貞』字也。
units.en: Thus the initial posthumous name was Wen, and did not have the graph 'zhen'.
units.literal: Thus the initial posthumous name was Wen, and did not have the graph 'zhen'.

units.zh: 禮志及文帝紀並稱舞陽宣文侯，宋書禮志同。
units.en: The Treatise on Rites and the Basic Annals of Emperor Wen both call him Marquis Xuanwen of Wuyang, and the Treatise on Rites in the Song shu is the same.
units.literal: The Treatise on Rites and the Basic Annals of Emperor Wen both call him Marquis Xuanwen of Wuyang, and the Treatise on Rites in the Song shu is the same.

units.zh: 此云『文宣』，亦轉寫之誤。」
units.en: Here saying 'Wenxuan' is also a copying error."
units.literal: Here saying 'Wenxuan' is also a copying error."

units.zh: 今據改。
units.en: Corrected per collation.
units.literal: Now emended accordingly.
